against.head: Heavy selling on the dip
against.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.
against.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 74% above its 50-day average: sellers are leaving in size.

against.head: Stochastic leaving overbought
against.learn: Where the close sits in the recent range, 0-100; leaving 20 or 80 marks a turn.
against.text: The stochastic fell back below 80 (to 76) on Oct 16: buying pressure easing.

EWZ.change: A daily close below −7.1%, under the wave-1 high: wave 4 never overlaps it, proves it wrong. So would heavy selling into the buy zone.
considered: Swings: higher highs and higher lows

Relative strength vs SPY: +15% in 3 months
MACD: above its signal line and above zero

EWZ.gist: A stock in an uptrend at support (the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 (Sep 29–Oct 5) and the February breakout level); it is in its wave-4 buy zone.

why: a clean wave 4 at its zone

plan.sentence: Buy the reaction between −4.9% and +0.1% from the Oct 16 close: a daily close up inside the zone. Target +12%, then +20%. Out on a daily close below −7.1%.
plan.why_out: the wave-1 high: wave 4 never overlaps it
plan.why_t1: wave 5's usual reach, 0.618 of waves 1 to 3
plan.why_zone: the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 (Sep 29–Oct 5), the February breakout level and the 38.2% retracement of the Sep 29–Oct 5 rise

standouts.head: Wave 4 in its buy zone
standouts.learn: After waves 1 to 3 up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.382 and 0.5 retracement of wave 3, above the top of wave 1. A daily close up inside the zone is the buy; a close under the wave-1 high ends the count.
standouts.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Aug 28 to Oct 5 (+25%; wave 3 is 1.9 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−2.3% to −4.5%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the February breakout level and the 38.2% retracement of the Sep 29–Oct 5 rise in the same place. The count is wrong on a daily close under the wave-1 high (−6.5%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.

standouts.head: A breakaway gap up
standouts.learn: A gap out of a range on heavy volume that holds: the start of a move.
standouts.text: On Oct 5 it gapped up out of a tight range on 7.8x volume and has held (+12% at the open).

standouts.head: Uptrend on every average
standouts.learn: Higher highs and higher lows, with price above rising averages.
standouts.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.

standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.
standouts.text: Price sits on the average price paid since the Sep 29 low and the Apr 14 high: 2 kinds of level at one price.

standouts.head: A bull flag
standouts.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.
standouts.text: It ran +22% in 9 sessions, then drifted for 4 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 30% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.

EWZ.take: EWZ: it is in an uptrend on every average, and it sits on support at the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 (Sep 29–Oct 5) and the February breakout level. It is in its wave-4 buy zone, and there is a breakaway gap up. Against it, the dip is coming on heavy selling. This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
